description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wattala, Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 512000
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations regarding title to specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about land parcels, their owners, extents, encumbrances, and legal status, which falls squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
